csv_project_name: Developers for Bittersweet Site Housing Development
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Lansing, Kansas, is soliciting qualifications from experienced development teams for the potential development of a missing-middle inspired housing neighborhood on city-owned property known as the Bittersweet Site. The city seeks qualified respondents with demonstrated experience in neighborhood-scaled residential development, site-sensitive design, financing, and public-private partnership implementation. This RFQ is intended to identify one or more qualified development teams with the experience, financial capacity, and project vision necessary to work with the city on a proposed residential development of approximately 60 to 80 dwelling units on approximately 5.4 acres of developable land.
